clue.text: Bows? Not likely!

definitions.meaning: the bows used to play violins, which are informally called fiddles
a dismissive exclamation meaning nonsense or rubbish

explanation.definitionFit: Violin bows are informally fiddle-sticks, and the same word is an old exclamation of scornful disbelief.

clue.text: Loud rough leader of the Northern States

parts.note: F is forte, the musical direction for loud

indicators.note: rough suggests something knocked out of shape, so the next word's letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A loud, coarse man leads the northern states.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Loud rough' reads as a description of a man; 'rough' is the anagram signal. In the American Civil War the Northern (Union) side were the Federals.
explanation.definitionFit: The Union side in the American Civil War was the Federal side, as against the Confederate South.

clue.text: Plan to have a drink, say

indicators.note: say signals that the word for a drink is spoken, giving a different spelling

parts.note: a draught is a swallow or drink of liquid

explanation.surface: Someone plans to have a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' gives the sound of DRAUGHT, a drink, which is spelt DRAFT.
explanation.definitionFit: A draft is a preliminary version or outline, so it means a plan.

clue.text: This knight may see a female smile

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or see
a hen is a female bird
a grin is a broad smile

explanation.surface: A gallant knight might catch sight of a woman smiling.
explanation.walkthrough: Lohengrin is the Swan Knight of Arthurian legend and the hero of Wagner's opera.
explanation.definitionFit: Lohengrin is the knight of the Holy Grail in German legend and Wagner's opera.

clue.text: Kind of music that has spirit

definitions.meaning: a genre of African-American popular music
the immortal essence of a person

explanation.surface: Some music is said to have real spirit.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a genre of Black American popular music and a person's inner spirit or essence.

clue.text: Show for many in Bharat, note

indicators.note: in places the word for many inside the country's name

parts.note: Bharat is the Hindi name for India
C is the Roman numeral for 100, a crossword many
te is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A show staged for large audiences in India, take note.
explanation.definitionFit: To indicate is to point out or show something.

clue.text: Food like baby's beef extract

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as printed 'Food like baby's beef extract (5)': no parse found giving KEBAB; BAB may be baby but nothing supplies KE

clue.text: Framework for pearls? That's odd

indicators.note: odd suggests the letters are in a strange arrangement, so they are rearranged

parts.note: ie is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: Someone thinks a framework for pearls a strange notion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'odd' shuffles PEARLS with IE (that is, from 'That's').
explanation.definitionFit: An espalier is a lattice or trellis on which fruit trees are trained flat.

clue.text: Time for Gilbert's classical pops

parts.note: W S Gilbert's Mikado song mentions the 'classical ... Pops', the Victorian popular concerts in London; the weekday they were held is the time

explanation.surface: When Gilbert's light classical concerts took place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pops' looks like soft drinks or bangs; it is the popular concerts held weekly at St James's Hall in Victorian London, mentioned by Gilbert in The Mikado.
explanation.definitionFit: The Victorian Popular Concerts mentioned in Gilbert's lyric took their name from the weekday they were given.

clue.text: A nuisance having to follow one pursuing a false trail

parts.note: a drag is a tedious nuisance
to hound is to follow or pursue relentlessly

explanation.surface: A pest keeps tailing someone who is on the wrong scent.
explanation.walkthrough: A draghound hunts an artificial scent dragged over the ground rather than a live fox.
explanation.definitionFit: A draghound is trained to follow an artificial scent laid along the ground, not a real quarry.

clue.text: Graduates thus as a singer

parts.note: BA is Bachelor of Arts, so BAs are graduates
so means thus, in this way

explanation.surface: Graduates go on to become singers.
explanation.definitionFit: A basso is a bass vocalist, the lowest male voice.

clue.text: Deserving a reprimand

definitions.meaning: a sharp scolding, from the verb rate, to berate

explanation.surface: Someone is in line for a telling-off.
explanation.definitionFit: To rate means to merit, and also, in an older sense, to scold, so the noun is a scolding.

clue.text: The case of the blackleg poet

parts.note: a scab is a strikebreaker, a blackleg
a bard is a poet

explanation.surface: The story of the strikebreaking poet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'case' reads like a story or affair; it is a sheath for a sword. A blackleg is British slang for a worker who breaks a strike.
explanation.definitionFit: A scabbard is the sheath or case for a sword's blade.

clue.text: Standards for the French backing a horse

parts.note: la is French for the (feminine)

indicators.note: backing means the horse's name runs backwards

parts.note: an Arab is a breed of horse

explanation.surface: Flags carried by the French, who back a horse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' is the reversal signal. A labarum was the imperial Roman banner adopted by Constantine; labara is its plural.
explanation.definitionFit: A labarum was the Roman imperial banner or standard, so the plural means several such flags.

clue.text: Russian police chief's about turn which may cause ill-feeling

indicators.note: about means the police chief's name goes round the word for a turn

parts.note: Lavrentiy Beria headed Stalin's secret police
a turn is an act, as in a music-hall turn

explanation.surface: A Soviet police boss's sudden U-turn leaves people feeling sore.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about turn' looks like a reversal; 'about' is the container and 'turn' gives ACT.
explanation.definitionFit: Some microbes are germs that bring on illness, so feeling ill is a literal sense.

clue.text: Reform one Tory act — it's an outrage

indicators.note: reform means form again, so the letters are reshaped

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A political act passed by the Conservatives provokes fury.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reform' rearranges I, TORY and ACT.
explanation.definitionFit: An atrocity is a shocking, wicked deed, something outrageous.

clue.text: Upsets patent tea-makers

parts.note: patent means obvious, overt
urns are large vessels for making tea

explanation.surface: Patented tea-making machines cause trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'patent' reads as a noun about inventions; it is the adjective meaning plain to see.
explanation.definitionFit: To overturn something is to upset or capsize it.

clue.text: Daredevil told not to do so much damage

indicators.note: told signals that the phrase is spoken and heard as another word

parts.words: not to do so much damage
parts.note: to wreck less is to do less damage

explanation.surface: A daredevil is warned to cause less destruction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'told' points to the sound: WRECK LESS, meaning do less damage, is heard as the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Used as an adjective, daredevil means rashly bold and heedless of danger.

clue.text: Discourage introduction of tin container for wine

indicators.note: introduction of means putting the next word into the word for discourage

parts.note: to deter is to discourage
a can is a tin

explanation.surface: Discouraging the use of tins for wine.
explanation.definitionFit: A decanter is a glass vessel into which wine is poured to serve.

clue.text: He owes more than the cattle dealer

parts.note: DR is short for debtor, one who owes
over means more than

explanation.surface: A man in more debt than the cattle trader.
explanation.walkthrough: DR also stands for debtor in accounts.
explanation.definitionFit: A drover drives livestock to market and may deal in them.

clue.text: Looked intently for members of the second and fourth estates

parts.note: peers, the Lords, form the second estate of the realm
the press is the fourth estate, and ED is an editor

explanation.surface: Lords and journalists stared hard.
explanation.walkthrough: The traditional estates of the realm are clergy, nobility and commons; the press is commonly called the fourth estate.
explanation.definitionFit: To peer is to look closely or with effort.

clue.text: The joy of the Camptown ladies

definitions.text: The joy of the Camptown ladies

parts.words: The joy of the Camptown ladies
parts.note: the song Camptown Races has its ladies singing in dialect, where the is de; so 'the light' in their speech is a word for joy

explanation.surface: What the women of Camptown take pleasure in.
explanation.walkthrough: In the minstrel song, 'De Camptown ladies sing dis song', the dialect turns 'the' into 'de'.
explanation.definitionFit: Joy and delight are synonyms for great pleasure.

clue.text: Concerning some filming in pass

parts.note: over means concerning, as in a row over money
a take is one filmed shot

explanation.surface: A clause about shooting scenes in a mountain pass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pass' looks like a mountain route; it is the verb, to go past.
explanation.definitionFit: To overtake is to pass a vehicle going the same way.

clue.text: Championship of the right

definitions.meaning: a sporting crown held by the champion
a legal claim to ownership of property

explanation.surface: A championship belonging to the right side.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means a sporting crown and also legal entitlement to ownership.

clue.text: Don't hurry. — that's the way with bread

parts.note: St is street, a way
a roll is a small loaf of bread

explanation.surface: A baker's advice: take your time with bread.
explanation.definitionFit: To stroll is to walk in a leisurely way, without hurrying.

clue.text: Colour of wood

definitions.meaning: the hard timber of the tree that bears the fruit

explanation.surface: The shade of some timber.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a yellow-green colour and the fine-grained timber of the Mediterranean tree.

clue.text: The deil's mischief for these hands

definitions.text: The deil's mischief for these hands

indicators.note: mischief suggests the letters are made to misbehave and swap places

parts.note: deil is the Scots word for the devil

explanation.surface: The devil finds mischief for such hands to do.
explanation.walkthrough: The proverb 'the devil finds work for idle hands' is the picture; 'mischief' rearranges DEIL.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb says the devil makes work for hands that are unoccupied.

clue.text: Samuel's' teacher turns to George

parts.note: in the Bible the priest Eli brought up the boy Samuel

indicators.note: turns means the little word to is read backwards

explanation.surface: Samuel's teacher turns to someone called George.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns to' reads as a single phrase; 'turns' reverses TO. George is the novelist Mary Ann Evans's pen name.
explanation.definitionFit: George was the pen-name first name of the Victorian novelist Mary Ann Evans.

clue.text: Which place is' said to entertain approval?

parts.note: which is said like witch, and the Witch of Endor appears in the Bible, so the witch's place is Endor
to sing is to entertain an audience

explanation.surface: Where would you say approval is welcomed?
explanation.walkthrough: 'entertain' looks like a container but simply means sing. 'Which' sounds like witch, and the biblical Witch of Endor was consulted by King Saul.
explanation.definitionFit: Endorsing a plan means giving it official backing, a form of support.

clue.text: The: turbulent masses resent change of 11

indicators.note: turbulent means in disorder, so the letters are churned up

explanation.surface: Unruly crowds resent having their standing revised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turbulent' rearranges MASSES RESENT; 11 across is RATING, an assessment.
explanation.definitionFit: Changing a rating means assessing it again.
